# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Managed memory improvements**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves managed memory use across image pixels, font features, and stream decoding. Image pixel copies and HarfBuzz feature-string decoding reduce temporary allocations, while front-buffered streams no longer retain data unnecessarily.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Managed pixel copies optimized** — Image pixel-copy operations reduce managed overhead when moving pixel data between SkiaSharp and application buffers. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **Font feature decoding avoids native allocations** — Feature-string decoding now avoids an unnecessary native allocation while preserving its existing results. ([#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **HarfBuzz text encoding buffers are reused** — UTF-32 encoding for HarfBuzz operations now reuses buffers to reduce temporary managed allocations. ([#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060))

## Bug Fixes

- **Front-buffered streams release retained data** — Front-buffered stream handling no longer keeps buffered data alive after it is no longer needed. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
